verdict.rationale: Metorial is an infrastructure/connector platform that lets external AI agents and MCP clients (Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, custom bots) access tools and integrations — it does not itself ship a built-in AI assistant that a user chats with or delegates tasks to inside the product. Sample 'bots' and 'Magic Skills' are workflow templates built using external LLM providers, not a native in-product assistant, so this axis is a category mismatch for a dev-infrastructure/MCP hub product.
